Toasted triple-stack club sandwiches of roast turkey, crispy bacon, tomato, cos and herb mayo, cut into small triangles and pinned with toothpicks. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped chives and a little Dijon. For each club, spread 3 slices of toast with mayo, then layer 300g sliced roast turkey and cos on the first, bacon and sliced tomato on the second, and close with the third. Press down, pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles. Serve with crisps.

Chicken, leek, carrot and peas in a creamy thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, baked until it bubbles up through the edges. Heat the oven to 200C. Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in 20g butter, remove. Cook 2 sliced leeks, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 6 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Add the chicken, 150g frozen peas, thyme, salt and pepper. Spoon into a pie dish, top with 1 puff pastry sheet, cut a vent, brush with egg and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
W: Shortbread base, golden caramel and milk chocolate top
Shortbread base, thick caramel of condensed milk and golden syrup, set with a layer of milk chocolate and cut into squares.
K: Thick vanilla ice cream milkshake served in tall cups
Vanilla ice cream blended with cold milk and a dash of vanilla until thick, poured into tall cups with a straw.

s.note: Cheese curds in a crisp lager batter, fried and served with dipping sauce
s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 1 egg, 200ml lager and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter. Dip 400g cheese curds in batches and fry at 185C for 90 seconds until puffed and golden. Drain on paper and serve straight away with 150ml ranch dressing.

s.note: Double-fried russet fries with salt and paprika in paper cones
s.how: Cut 1kg russet potatoes into thin fries, soak 30 minutes and dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes and cool, then fry again at 190C for 3 minutes until golden. Toss with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp sweet paprika and serve in paper cones.

m.note: Smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles, onion, special sauce
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and top with American cheese. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickle. Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with sauce, pickles and diced onion.

w.note: Shortbread base, golden caramel and milk chocolate top
w.how: Rub 125g butter into 200g flour with 50g sugar, press into a lined 20x30cm tin and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Simmer 395g condensed milk, 60g butter and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 6 minutes until thick and golden, pour over and bake 10 minutes. Cool, top with 200g melted milk chocolate and cut into squares.

d.note: Thick vanilla ice cream milkshake served in tall cups
d.how: Blend 1L vanilla ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall cups and serve with straws straight away.
